title: At 49, he beat surfers half his age
description:
Kelly Slater: youngest world surfing champion in history at 20, oldest at 39, and winner of the 2022 Pipeline Masters days before his 50th birthday - against surfers half his age, at the wave that breaks over shallow reef on Oahu's North Shore.
11 world titles and 56 championship tour wins, both all-time records. No other man in the sport's history has more than four titles.
